Visitor replaces form with custom output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorFormCustom struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorFormCustom) VisitForm(ctx htmd.NodeContext, action *string, method *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(`[FORM PLACEHOLDER]`)
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorFormCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<div><form action="/submit" method="POST"><label>Name: <input type="text" name="name"></label><button type="submit">Submit</button></form></div>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
